description: Take a shallow DOM snapshot of one open surface or targetId, or list what is open (listTargets on the debug port, listTabs). Closed shadow roots and probes: extension_inspect.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

listTabs.description: List tabs with ids and return.

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

tab.description: chrome.tabs id; else url, else the active tab.

tabUrl.description: The tab by url from the target list.

targetId.description: A page's targetId (extension_open, or dom_snapshot listTargets); overrides url.

withConsole.description: Console lines: a count, or true for 50.

name: extension_dom_snapshot
